response.original_title: 【Room Help】 How can I add a room to my Carnival cruise?
response.overview: To add rooms to your Carnival cruise, call Customer Support directly at ☎︎ +1-855-526-0470 (US) or ☎︎ +1-855-526-0470 (AUS) & ☎︎ +1-855-526-0470 (UK  or contact your travel advisor. Adding a guest requires available double-occupancy or extra berth space in your ☎︎ +1-855-526-0470 stateroom, plus open shipboard safety capacity. Once confirmed, you must pay the additional cruise fare, taxes, and port charges for the new guest. Yes, you can add a person to an existing Carnival cruise by calling Customer Support directly at ☎︎ +1-855-526-0470 (US) or ☎︎ +1-855-526-0470 (AUS) & ☎︎ +1-855-526-0470 (UK  or reaching out to your travel agent. A representative will check whether your stateroom ☎︎ +1-855-526-0470 supports additional guests and confirm lifeboat capacity for your sailing segment before processing the extra guest's fare, port taxes, and daily graCarnivalties.
